# LiteLLM observability and caching — concept pack (small)

## Parameters and configuration

- [fact] Semantic caching scopes buckets by key, team and organization. End users sharing a virtual key share that bucket unless semantic_cache_scope: end_user and an authenticated end-user identifier are present; absent end-user identity falls back to key scope. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/caching_semantic · keywords: LiteLLM observability and caching · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/caching/caching.py
- [fact] ttl sets entry retention and s-maxage limits acceptable cached age. Redis expiration removes keys when their lifetime elapses; neither setting establishes answer freshness after upstream documents, tools or authorization change. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/caching_controls · keywords: LiteLLM observability and caching · also: https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/keyspace/, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/caching/caching.py
- [fact] OTel v2 is opt-in with LITELLM_OTEL_V2=true. OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT defaults to no_content; span_only, event_only and span_and_event select capture destinations. LITELLM_OTEL_INTEGRATION_ENABLE_METRICS and LITELLM_OTEL_INTEGRATION_ENABLE_EVENTS are separate boolean flags that default to false at the inspected commit. Pin the integration generation and verify exported traces instead of copying v1 assumptions into v2. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/observability/opentelemetry_v2 · keywords: LiteLLM observability and caching · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/integrations/otel/model/config.py

## How-to and procedures

- [fact] A namespace prefixes cache keys; it is not itself an access-control rule. Use Redis ACL key patterns and credentials to restrict cache access, then confirm the configured namespace covers every proxy key class. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/caching_redis · keywords: LiteLLM observability and caching · also: https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/oss_and_stack/management/security/acl/, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/caching/caching.py
- [fact] Normalize total input-token usage across cached and uncached provider fields. OpenTelemetry specifies inclusive input totals; Anthropic documents input_tokens plus cache_creation_input_tokens plus cache_read_input_tokens. Do not label uncached input alone as total prompt size. — https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/registry/attributes/gen-ai/ · keywords: LiteLLM observability and caching · also: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Redis maxmemory-policy can evict entries before their TTL expires. noeviction instead rejects memory-growing writes; investigate memory policy and failed writes when cache hit rate falls rather than assuming only TTL caused misses. — https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/reference/eviction/
- [fact] Exact cache keys hash recognized LLM request parameters; provider-specific optional parameters need enable_caching_on_provider_specific_optional_params. Tenant identity is not automatically included for exact caching. Add a trusted tenant namespace and test cross-tenant identical requests. — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/caching/caching.py · keywords: LiteLLM observability and caching · also: https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/security_owasp_llm_top10
- [fact] Langfuse mask_input and mask_output request metadata do not redact the legacy OpenTelemetry logger. Use explicit NO_CONTENT or turn_off_message_logging, and inspect exported spans and events for residual metadata. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/observability/opentelemetry_integration · keywords: LiteLLM observability and caching · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/integrations/opentelemetry.py
- [statement] OTel v2 attribute include_list or exclude_list filters metric labels, not span attributes. Excluding high-cardinality metric fields does not establish a trace-content privacy policy. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/observability/opentelemetry_v2
- [fact] Semantic caching excludes conversation content from its bucket key and searches similarity within that bucket. The guide warns that multi-turn agents can replay stale responses, including tool calls; retain exact caching or disable semantic replay unless correctness is demonstrated. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/caching_semantic · keywords: LiteLLM observability and caching · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/caching/caching.py

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [fact] LiteLLM response caching reuses a stored response and can avoid a new model call. Semantic caching selects similar embedded prompts; provider prompt caching reuses input processing instead of replaying a complete answer. Keep their hit and correctness metrics separate. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/caching · keywords: LiteLLM observability and caching · also: https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/caching_semantic, https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/completion/prompt_caching
- [statement] Local and disk response caches are not shared across workers or replicas. Redis is the documented shared-cache choice for multi-worker deployments; compare hit rates per worker before interpreting latency as model performance. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/caching
